title.en: About Us | Independent Real Estate Advisory in Portugal | Smith & Adams
Independent advisory, built around the investor

subtitle.en: Since 2020, Smith & Adams has helped international investors build euro-denominated property portfolios in Portugal, and secure residency where that’s part of the plan.

body.en: Smith & Adams is a Lisbon-based real estate investment advisory firm. We give investors an independent view of the Portuguese property market, then go further: coordinating an end-to-end solution across planning, development, construction, and property management, so a single advisory relationship covers the full lifecycle of the investment.

Our focus is simple: help objective investors maximise the return on any tangible asset they acquire, while keeping ownership genuinely hands-off. From the first conversation to ongoing management, everything we do is built around that outcome.

Suelen Pires founded Smith & Adams with a focus on real estate and Golden Visa advisory, working closely with strategic partners on sales and property management, and building the trust the firm is structured around today.
Smith & Adams advised on and structured the Campolide collection across more than 10 buildings, bringing the authentic ‘Lisboeta’ soul to modern living.
Smith & Adams brought every detail closer to home, assuming full responsibility for sales and property management, ensuring that every client is welcomed with care and dedication.
The acquisition of Hygge Kaffe officially wove the Hygge philosophy into the soul of Smith & Adams.
Smith & Adams’ vision travelled across borders with the opening of a new office in Dubai, bringing us closer to our clients on the other side of the world.
In the heart of Lisbon, the Hygge Baixa Hotel opened as an urban sanctuary, advised on and now managed by Smith & Adams, where signature design meets the art of slowing down.
Smith & Adams took on the Hygge Fanqueiros project, a historic boutique stay where the comfort of home meets the ritual of a perfect coffee, advised, structured and now managed by us.

The Hygge Beato project marks the flagship of our vision: 137 curated studios within an apart-hotel structure, advised and structured by Smith & Adams, where thoughtful design meets a deep sense of belonging.

We identify and structure real estate investment opportunities in Portugal, advising on asset selection, legal and tax framework, financing, and long-term strategy, for investors focused on capital preservation, euro income, and steady growth.

We coordinate immigration and legal services for clients pursuing Golden Visa or D2 Visa residency, working alongside specialised law firms and regulated partners to manage the visa process, property transaction, and family inclusion end to end.

For properties we’ve advised on, and for independent owners, we manage every asset to maximise its yield potential, backed by a proven track record of over 90% occupancy across our short-term rental portfolio. From tenant relations and maintenance to financial reporting, we handle the day-to-day so ownership from abroad stays genuinely hands-off.
Since 2020, Smith & Adams has grown into a Lisbon-based advisory platform serving investors and Residency Investors from across Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the Americas.

bullets.en: Advised and supported 1,000+ international investors building euro-denominated portfolios in Portugal.
Expanded its presence across Lisbon and key Portuguese cities, operating from Lisbon as its main hub.
Attracted clients from dozens of countries across Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the Americas — reflecting a truly global client base.

eyebrow.en: A message from our Head of Investment

photo_alt.en: George Hobson, Head of Investment & Strategy at Smith & Adams

bio.en: George Hobson leads investment and strategy at Smith & Adams, setting how the group reads the Portuguese market and how each investment is structured — from the first appraisal through to handover and management.

He has spent more than a decade in Portuguese real estate. As a senior investment broker in Lisbon he advised international buyers on residential and yield-focused acquisitions, and earlier built and ran his own brokerage in the Algarve — giving him a view of the market from the ground up, in both regions where foreign capital concentrates.
That experience sits behind the way the group works: independent advice first, held to a single standard the whole way through.

lead.en: We built Smith & Adams around one idea: that you should be able to own property in Portugal without having to become an expert in Portugal.

body.en: Most investors arrive with the same two questions — is this a good asset, and who looks after it once I have bought it? Answering only the first is what the market usually offers. We give an independent read on the Portuguese property market and then stay on: planning, development, construction and management sit inside the same relationship, so nobody hands you off at the point where the work actually starts.

Portugal earns the attention. It offers residency routes into the European Union for both entrepreneurs and passive investors, a legal system that treats foreign ownership the same as domestic, and cities where the demand for good, well-run housing has outrun the supply of it. That combination is rarer than it sounds.

What we ask you to judge us on is evidence rather than argument. More than 1,000 investors, over €300M placed and 300+ assets under management — and, on this site, the occupancy of our own buildings with the dates and the source attached. If a number matters to your decision, you should be able to see where it came from.
